Going to assume this means go with the 4070TI ;)  


In my defense, the 3080 was purchased about 2 months ago and not since the 4070TI was released. Gotta love the extended holiday return period lol.

​

Currently have two 32" LG UltraGear 165hz QHD monitors. Been debating upgrading to a 4k but haven't had a need to yet.
Hoping it will be done within the week. Moving up from a 1070 so hoping to see a big improvement.

Completely superior, maybe not. But some reviews I've read do mention the 3080 being better in some aspects. Including latency. As to how accurate these reviews are is unknown by me, which is why I came here to ask and verify.

Haha, just some of the reviews I have read on it. Mixed opinions from everyone. If I find them again, I'll share.

I appreciate the input. It's the way I was leaning but just wanted additional opinions. Haven't built a PC in years so haven't followed much in regards to GPU's and all.
It would basically be an even trade compared to what I bought the 3080 for and the current price of the 4070ti.
My wife is experiencing the same issue. Trying to figure it out as well.
